title: Bias Intimidation
grade_or_penalty: One degree higher than the underlying offense; 4th degree when the underlying offense is a DP or PDP offense; 1st degree when the underlying offense is 1st degree
key_points: Committing (or attempting) certain offenses with purpose to intimidate, or knowing the conduct would intimidate, because of race, color, religion, gender, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin or ethnicity.
